from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
path=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u033/system/state/workspace/programs/task-433a0aca.py')
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            if row[c] == background and row[c - 1] != background and row[c - 1] == row[c + 1]:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
